notes.title: Respawn——Fresh New Version of EASE OUT is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[h1]Respawn——Fresh New Version of EASE OUT is Coming Soon![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43164536/115c6a1d1083ea3bcbc62fffbf6ac53c61cb2bdf.png[/img]

In early March, Float Gaming Studio officially took over the project and will undergo a major update. Due to the development plan of the game, in order to continue bringing high-quality game works and a good experience, it has been decided to change the pricing from free to 6 RMB (0.99 USD) [b]POSSIBLY

notes.title: Happy new year from Ease Out!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=CZXv03QjQSI;full]https://youtu.be/CZXv03QjQSI[/previewyoutube]

It's the New Year again.

In the past year, Ease Out has gone from an idea to a game, completely without the support and opinions of the players!

Thank you to all the players who gave us their valuable opinions and suggestions, you are our motivation to keep this game going!

Thank you to everyone from Flash Rhythm Record and March Record, without you, we would not be able to have the scale we have now!

In the new year, all of us at ON Gaming Studio wish you all a happy and prosperous year!

Thank you all!

notes.title: 12/29 update
notes.notes:
Sorry for the gap in the weekly update... All of our developers are covid positive...
I'm sorry for the two weeks of broken work and the new songs that have not yet been updated. There will be.

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] 颅内震荡 added two new difficulties
[*] Optimized UI architecture
[*] Notes now flow faster
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that if you press space when no song is selected, it will open a random song directly without focusing on it.
[*] Fixed a bug in the tutorial-level animation
[/list]

notes.title: [Ease Out x Flash Rhythm] Collaboration Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43164536/c3c0bfd379c7399cc1667f27c2f44f3949fcc59c.png[/img]

Today we are proud to announce that we will have a long-term collaboration with the fantastic music label **Flash Rhythm Record**, and provide all our players with new levels!

In the following weeks, in addition to the weekly update, we will pick one of the adopted songs of Flash Rhythm Record to present to all our players every other Wednesday, and add one additional difficulty to one of the existing levels.

At the same time, players who have the ability to compose songs are welcome to contact the Flash Rhythm label, maybe our next collaboration song is your own!

Our QQ group：783480389

Discord：https://discord.gg/WQQ2mXCgXr

QQ group of Flash Rhythm Record（Verification: Ease Out contribution）：895366640

SoundCloud：https://soundcloud.com/flash-rhythm-record
